claims.statement: Caret on an entity attribute plus Alt+Enter offers Create Spring Data repository method, opening the query window with that attribute context.
claims.supports: intention on entity attribute offers "Create Spring Data repository method" ... opens the window with the attribute context

claims.statement: A quick action on an unresolved repository method call opens the query creation wizard.
claims.supports: call a method that does not exist yet, open the wizard from a quick action on the unresolved reference
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Action 'Create repository method from this call…' (file action at the call site). Not checked: Alt+Enter intention surface and the query creation wizard (no wizard; confirm preview).
